question:
Choose the option which is antonym of (opposite of) the word "construe" in the sentence given below:

His silence was misunderstood by many as a lack of interest, when in reality, he was deeply engrossed in thought.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"construe"** means to interpret or understand the meaning of something, often in a particular way. (व्याख्या करना)

 
 
• **Example: **She tried to **construe** his ambiguous statement as a compliment.
 
 
 
• **"Misunderstood" **refers to failing to interpret or understand something correctly. (गलत समझना)
 
 
• **Example: **His intentions were** misunderstood** by everyone at the meeting.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'construe' **is **'misunderstood'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Engrossed **(तल्लीन): Deeply involved or absorbed in something.

 
 
• **Example:** He was so engrossed in his book that he didn't hear the phone ring.
 
 
 
• **Interest **(रुचि): The feeling of wanting to know or learn about something or someone.
 
 
• **Example: **She has a great interest in classical music.
 
 
 
• **Silence** (मौन): The absence of sound or noise.
 
 
• **Example:** The silence in the library was calming.
